LiLiFreeDrinks.name: Free Drinks
LiLiFreeDrinks.description: Healing Brew's cooldown is reduced by 1 second and its Mana cost is refunded if it heals a Hero under 50% Health.

LiLiMasteryCloudSerpentSerpentSidekick.name: Serpent Sidekick
LiLiMasteryCloudSerpentSerpentSidekick.description: Cloud Serpent no longer costs Mana and while Fast Feet is active its cooldown refreshes an additional 75% faster.

LiLiEagerAdventurer.name: Eager Adventurer
LiLiEagerAdventurer.description: Increase Fast Feet's duration by 150% and increase Mana regeneration by 150% while Fast Feet is active.

LiLiWindSerpent.name: Wind Serpent
LiLiWindSerpent.description: Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Blinding Wind increases this bonus to 20% for 3 seconds. Passive: Cloud Serpent attacks 25% faster.

LiLiMasteryBlindingWindSurgingWinds.name: Surging Winds
LiLiMasteryBlindingWindSurgingWinds.description: If Blinding Wind hits 2 Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds and Li Li gains 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

LiLiMasteryFastFeetSafetySprint.name: Safety Sprint
LiLiMasteryFastFeetSafetySprint.description: Activate to gain Fast Feet, 30 Armor, and 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds. Passive: While Fast Feet is active, Li Li gains 10 Armor.

LiLiMasteryHealingBrewTheGoodStuff.name: The Good Stuff
LiLiMasteryHealingBrewTheGoodStuff.description: Healing Brew heals for an additional 42 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds. While Fast Feet is active, this heal amount is increased by 100%.

LiLiMasteryBlindingWindMassVortex.name: Mass Vortex
LiLiMasteryBlindingWindMassVortex.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blinding Wind from 2 to 3. Blinding Wind deals 75% additional damage if all 3 enemies hit are Heroes.

LiLiLetsGo.name: Let's Go!
LiLiLetsGo.description: Activate to heal an allied Hero for 160 (+4% per level) and make them Unstoppable for 1 second. Let's Go's cooldown is affected by Fast Feet. Cannot be used on Li Li.

LiLiHeroicAbilityJugof1000Cups.name: Jug of 1,000 Cups
LiLiHeroicAbilityJugof1000Cups.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 66 (+4% per level) Health.

LiLiHeroicAbilityWaterDragon.name: Water Dragon
LiLiHeroicAbilityWaterDragon.description: Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.

LiLiMasteryCloudSerpentLightningSerpent.name: Lightning Serpent
LiLiMasteryCloudSerpentLightningSerpent.description: Cloud Serpent attacks bounce to hit 2 additional targets for 13 (+4% per level) damage and 10 (+4% per level) healing.

LiLiMasteryBlindingWindGaleForce.name: Gale Force
LiLiMasteryBlindingWindGaleForce.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Blind duration by 0.75 seconds. Li Li's Basic Attacks against Blinded Heroes deal 100% increased damage.

LiLiHinderingWinds.name: Hindering Winds
LiLiHinderingWinds.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Slow amount to 30% and its duration to 2 seconds.

LiLiMasteryHealingBrewTwoForOne.name: Two For One
LiLiMasteryHealingBrewTwoForOne.description: Increases the number of allies healed by Healing Brew to 2, but increases the cooldown by 1 second.

LiLiPickMeUp.name: Pick Me Up
LiLiPickMeUp.description: Healing Brew's healing for Heroes is increased by 33% if they are under 50% Health.

LiLiBlessingsOfYulon.name: Blessings Of Yu'lon
LiLiBlessingsOfYulon.description: Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased healing received and heals them for an additional 0.5% of their maximum Health each time it attacks.

LiLiMasteryJugof1000CupsJugof1000000Cups.name: Jug of 1,000,000 Cups
LiLiMasteryJugof1000CupsJugof1000000Cups.description: Jug of 1,000 Cups heals two allies at a time.

LiLiMasteryWaterDragonDoubleDragon.name: Double Dragon
LiLiMasteryWaterDragonDoubleDragon.description: After hitting a target with Water Dragon, another Water Dragon is summoned at the point of impact.

LiLiMistweaver.name: Mistweaver
LiLiMistweaver.description: Activate to heal nearby allied Heroes for 149 (+4% per level). Basic Attacks and Cloud Serpent attacks reduce the cooldown of Mistweaver by 1 second.

LiLiShakeItOff.name: Shake It Off
LiLiShakeItOff.description: Gain 35 Armor while Stunned, Silenced, or Rooted. Passive: Increase Fast Feet's cooldown refresh rate to 75%
